newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bufete to purchase $10 mln call options.
newsitem.headline: Bufete to purchase $10 mln call options.

text.p: Bufete Industrial, Mexico's construction giant, said on Thursday that it planned to purchase call options representing the right to acquire up to $10 million in shares of its own common stock.

It said the operation was aimed at allowing Bufete to benefit, subject to the terms of the call option, from any rise in the market value of the stock by receiving in cash any excess of the fair market value of the stock over the strike price of the option.
It said in a statement that the options would be purchased in one or more transactions from financial institutions, and that the terms would be agreed upon at the time of each purchase.
The options are expected to have maturities of four to 16 months following the dates of their purchase by Bufete, and will be settled in cash.
